manufacturing.rigid_parts: PLA with documented orientation; general parts40% infill plus solid bolt/key/rail lands. XT02 uprights and XT05 carrier require100% infill and at least6 walls. Effective directional stiffness remains measured acceptance, not bulk PLA modulus.
manufacturing.keys: Machine from shared C260 rod7.9375mm; turned3mm shank/M2 die-cut tip, milled5x6 head and one diamond pilot. Exact machining price unresolved.
manufacturing.beam_material: 18mm void-free birch plywood;300x56 blank from shared two-panel stock; receiving thickness18.00+/-0.10mm; finish seating datums and proof complete assembly
manufacturing.registration_allocation: Match and gauge assembly <=0.15mm unloaded; under2N proof incremental shift<=0.05mm, total<=0.20mm. Individual hole bounds do not alone certify full mechanism registration.

operation.index_preconditions: Empty/reset transfer locked in actual upper30mm dock. Live loop retained elsewhere, guide at checked rear-lowpark. Remove index pin, move rail, reinsert at station or60park.
operation.roll_change: At a support station only: empty transfer lift at 6mm stop and manually supported. Withdraw both M2 nuts85mm along -u, and both locating keys65mm along +u through authored rear access channels. Withdraw complete shoe/module12mm along -u; lift/lower30mm and rekey as required, reseat, reposition and refit keys/nuts. Detached pieces remain explicit operator-held solids. Park60 is upper-dock only; no dock/rekey operation at park.
operation.source_material_scope: Dock/index/rekey requires emptymodule; operator support is explicit. No yarn/material reset or hidden solids.
operation.fork_shoe_setting: One-time gauge fork to shoe within0.03mm and tighten twoM3 bolts. Fork/shoe remain joined during index and rekey. Under the2N assembly proof relative joint slip<=0.005mm, included in the0.010mm rail/joint deflection allocation.

key_pushrod.operation: Push from exposed M2 thread end after nut removal; no plier grip required inside5.1x6.1 channel. Rear rod pushes head for insertion. At full65mm ejection the front free grip length is19.2mm. Withdraw tool fully before module motion. Limit axial push to2N; stop if a key binds.
